audit_metadata.file_access_limitation: Workspace=D:\memory claw; project=D:\memorytable\cassandra-kg-memory. Analysis based on session-injected working memory.

erasure_key_correction: ENHANCEMENT IS VIEW-LEVEL, NOT DATA-LEVEL: BM25 Raw/BM25 RawERK share the same memory corpus but different text representation before indexing.

cat5_gap.issue: All 6 methods use legacy global corpus top10 for Cat5 queries, not the standard sample-scoped (conversation-level) retrieval used for Cat1-4
cat5_gap.impact: Cat5 F1/B1 numbers are valid but use a different candidate generation protocol than Cat1-4
cat5_gap.fix: Requires rebuilding full-scope retrieval for Cat5 queries with conversation-scoped candidates

parity_experiment_readiness.reason: All 6 methods perform computation in Python that reads from CSV. Replacing CSV reads with DB reads preserves identical computation logic.
parity_experiment_readiness.minimum_adapter: Replace open('memory_records.csv') → DB query; replace open('frozen_dense_scores_long.csv') → DB query or compute from DB-stored embeddings
parity_experiment_readiness.kg_specific_adapter: Dense+GlobalKG additionally needs DB query for KG triples (entity→relation→memory edges) instead of p3_memory_features.csv
